title: Teschner's Bondage Number Conjecture
exact_target: Can the domination number of every graph with an edge be increased by removing at most three halves of its maximum degree in edges?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1442 (GRAPH-055). CC BY 4.0.
Andrei Gagarin and Vadim Zverovich, The Bondage Number of Graphs on Topological Surfaces and Teschner’s Conjecture, arXiv:1209.1362v1 (2012), Section 1, definitions and Conjecture 1, pages 1--2.
